create_randomsearch_optimizer: create a RandomSearch one-shot optimizer with optional quasi-opposite sampling and auto scaling
create_samplingsearch_optimizer: create a SamplingSearch optimizer using Halton or Hammersley low-discrepancy sequences for uniform exploration
compute_avg_of_k_best: compute the average of the k best evaluated points from an optimization archive using dimfourth heuristic
compute_convex_limit: compute the maximum initial segment of points where quasiconvexity is verified using incremental convex hull
create_metarecentering_optimizer: create a MetaRecentering optimizer with scrambled Hammersley sampling and automatic rescaling for high-dimensional search
